content_sections.heading: GMC Narayanpet Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Candidates must pay an application fee of ₹500 (Rupees Five Hundred only), via Demand Draft drawn on the State Bank of India, in favour of the "Superintendent, Govt. General Hospital, Hospital Development Society, Narayanpet."

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GMC Narayanpet Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed Application Form from the official website of Government Medical College & General Hospital, Narayanpet (www.gmcnarayanpet.org), or from the official website of the District Collector, Narayanpet (https://narayanpet.telangana.gov.in). Fill in the application form completely with accurate personal, educational, and post-preference details. Prepare a Demand Draft of ₹500 in favour of the Superintendent, Govt. General Hospital, Hospital Development Society, Narayanpet, drawn on the State Bank of India. Submit the duly filled-in application, along with one set of Xerox copies of all relevant certificates and the originals for scrutiny. Ensure the application reaches the designated office on or before the closing date, 30.09.2026.

content_sections.heading: GMC Narayanpet Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Posts are on outsourcing basis only, for a period up to 31.03.2027, or till the actual need ceases, or till the regular posts are filled up, whichever is earlier - this does not confer any right to regular appointment. Candidates must possess the minimum qualification specified for the respective post; original certificates must be produced for scrutiny along with the application. For further queries, candidates may contact the College at Telephone Number 08506282506. Any updates or corrigenda regarding this recruitment will be published on the official websites listed above.

faq.question: Q1. What is GMC Narayanpet Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is Notification No. Rc.No.82/GMC/NRPT/2026, issued by the Principal, Government Medical College, Narayanpet, Telangana, for filling 149 posts across 35 categories on outsourcing basis at GMC & Government General Hospital, Narayanpet.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in GMC Narayanpet Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 149 total vacancies across 35 post categories, with Data Entry Operator (46), Lab Attendant (20), and Office Subordinate (20) being the largest categories.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for GMC Narayanpet Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications is 30.09.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for GMC Narayanpet Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹500, payable via Demand Draft in favour of the Superintendent, Govt. General Hospital, Hospital Development Society, Narayanpet.

faq.question: Q5. What is the tenure of these outsourcing posts?
faq.answer: Engagement is up to 31.03.2027, or till the actual need ceases, or till the regular posts are filled up, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for GMC Narayanpet outsourcing posts?
faq.answer: Monthly remuneration ranges from ₹15,600 (Cook, Office Subordinate, Lab Attendant, etc.) to ₹25,140 (Nursing Officer/Staff Nurse), depending on the post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification required for Data Entry Operator?
faq.answer: A Degree qualification along with a PG Diploma in Computer Application from a recognised institute.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for GMC Narayanpet Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must download the application form from www.gmcnarayanpet.org or https://narayanpet.telangana.gov.in, fill it in, attach the DD and required documents, and submit before 30.09.2026.
